attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions (State Board for Medicine)

topics.who: All PAs: infection control and barrier precautions coursework at initial licensure/registration and every 4 years (Public Health Law §239); attest at each registration
Prescribers with a DEA registration: 3 hours in pain management, palliative care and addiction once every 3 years; attest to NYSDOH

rules.notes: PAs are not on the NYSED list of professions with a CE requirement; only the mandated trainings apply. PAs are also not listed for the one-time child abuse training. Registration is for three years.
rules.legal_basis: Public Health Law §239 (infection control); NYSDOH mandatory prescriber education
